verdict.rationale: Letta ships an official TypeScript Agent SDK (`@letta-ai/letta-agent-sdk`) with in-depth first-party docs. They cover agent creation via `client.createAgent()`, session resume, typed streaming events, `canUseTool` permission callbacks, browser and React Native entry points, cloud/local deployment backends, MCP tool proxying, and several demo apps built on it. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript (e.g. Python), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK's quality.
